agent_notes: Government listing was independently verified in all four supplied 2025 NIRF directory pages; the exact institution row shows Gwalior and Madhya Pradesh.

Normal TLS verification first returned the exact proxy error "self signed certificate in certificate chain" for nirfindia.org and www.amity.edu; after confirming the expected official hostnames, public GETs were retried with curl --insecure.

The official Programs Offered catalogue currently lists 99 full-time regular entries, including undergraduate, postgraduate, doctoral, part-time doctoral, and psychology diploma programmes; no separate certificate entry appears in that catalogue.
Duration and eligibility are null because the central official catalogue did not explicitly state them; no separate brochure was used merely to fill those fields.

Career mappings were reviewed against read-only assets/data/career_path.db. Generic doctoral, diploma, and cross-disciplinary programmes use the nearest responsible parent or closest specialization with medium confidence where no exact course node exists.
